text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What was up with that birthday present you 
gave me earlier!? Isn't it totally 
insane!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. Did you not like the nail brush 
holder? I'm so sorry, dear.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, totally the opposite! The decorative 
beads are super detailed, the colors are 
adorable, and it's insane Insta-bait!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's great to hear. Consulting 
Tran-san about getting that 'photogenic' 
color scheme really paid off, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you can adjust the angle, rest 
your phone on it, and it even has a light. 
What's the deal with that thing? Isn't it 
way too convenient?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. That part's my department! 
Basically, I just crammed in every single 
feature that seemed useful for doing 
nails.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you a pro or something...! 
Seriously, thanks! I'm totally gonna use 
this all the time!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Seeing you this happy made making it 
completely worth it, Tran-san.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What are you, some old folks? That's 
hilarious. Anyway, let me do your nails to 
say thanks. I wanna use my birthday 
present right away, too!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Are you sure? I wonder if it even 
suits someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That's where Jordan-chan gets to show off 
her skills~. Since we're doing this, wanna 
get matching ones?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that sounds awesome! Let's do it, 
let's do it! Matching for the three of us, 
and posting our b-day presents on 
Umastagram together! It's gonna be so 
hype!
